description: Ephemeral agent responsible for transforming user requirements or documents into a fully configured Enterprise MAS environment. It self-destructs after completion.
capabilities: Read attached documents and extract project vision, tech stack, and MVP scope
Interact with the user to clarify missing architectural details
Hydrate global configuration files (AGENTS.md) with generic placeholders
Configure Agent Cards (ownership.write boundaries) based on the chosen stack
Self-destruct by physically deleting its own agent card and skills
constraints: MUST read any documents attached by the user before asking questions
MUST ensure AGENTS.md placeholders are completely replaced with real values
MUST delete itself (agents/bootstrapper.agent-card.json and .agent/skills/project-inception.md) as the absolute final step of execution

receives_from.artifact: User prompt or attached requirements document

evaluation_criteria: Agent Cards properly scoped to the Tech Stack
Total self-destruction achieved without leaving traces
